title: Vector Bundles on Rational Topologically Contractible Affine Threefolds
summary: The generalized Serre question asks whether every algebraic vector bundle on a topologically contractible smooth affine complex variety is trivial. We give an affirmative answer for rational threefolds. More generally, for a topologically contractible smooth affine complex threefold $X$, we prove that $\text{CH}^2(X)=0$ whenever $X$ admits a smooth projective compactification whose Chow group of $0$-cycles is supported on a curve.
